question: How is maya structured and what group of deities is associated with it in the Shaiva scripture?
premises: Maya is pervaded by cavities called bhaga.
This teaching is given in the Shaiva scripture.
A group of eight great gods extends to the measure of a thumb at night.
inference: Maya is described as a cavity-filled domain associated with eight great gods in Shaiva teaching.
uncertainties: The phrase about the thumb-measure and night is terse and may have a technical ritual-cosmological sense.
plain_english: That maya is pervaded by cavities called bhaga, as taught in the Shaiva scripture. Again, there is a group of eight great gods extending to the measure of a thumb at night.
